title: Speak to Nabla

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: What’s happening, babe? Got a job for Nabla?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What’s happening, babe? Got a job for Nabla?

nodes.text: Yo. Looking for Nabla?

nodes.text: Lower the blower, will you? You want a hacker? You want Nabla. Best there is. What's the job?

nodes.text: I can’t do anything, babe. But Nabla can.
